name: Viking Orbiter 1
about: Viking Orbiter 1 (1975-075A, JPL), launched 1975 Aug 20. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.004 au and aphelion 1.663 au against GCAT's 1.001 and 1.669
